column1: ; Mapping of portable test files to PIO test groups.
; Each `pio test -e serial` invocation builds one binary per subdirectory
; under test/ (the PIO grouping convention requires `test_` prefix). The
; ESP32-S3 has ~250 KB of DRAM heap, and doctest's TEST_CASE registration
; consumes ~278 bytes per case during static-init — so a single binary
; cannot hold the full ~1800-case portable suite. This manifest splits
; portable tests across multiple unit groups; sync_groups.sh re-creates
; the symlinks in test/test_units_*/ from this file.
